questions.question: Which type of soil erosion is characterized by small, well-defined channels created by running water?
questions.answer: B) Rill erosion

questions.question: Which of the following farm practices helps in conserving soil moisture?
questions.answer: B) Mulching

questions.question: Which crop vegetable is commonly established in a nursery bed before transplanting?
questions.answer: B) Tomatoes

questions.question: Which small domestic animal is mainly kept for wool and meat?
questions.answer: B) Sheep

questions.question: What is the primary function of a rake on the farm?
options: C) Leveling soil and collecting trash
questions.answer: C) Leveling soil and collecting trash

questions.question: An external parasite that attaches to the skin of livestock and sucks blood is a:
questions.answer: C) Tick

questions.question: Which simple method can be used to scare away birds from field crops?
questions.answer: A) Using a scarecrow

questions.question: Why is it important to keep farm inventory records?
options: A) To make the farm look neat
B) To keep track of farm assets and equipment
C) To increase rainfall on the farm
D) To stop weeds from growing
questions.answer: B) To keep track of farm assets and equipment

questions.question: Which practice involves removing excess seedlings from a seedbed to allow proper spacing?
questions.answer: B) Thinning

questions.question: Which water conservation structure collects and stores rainwater from rooftop gutters?
questions.answer: A) Water tank

questions.question: Define soil erosion and state two human activities that lead to soil erosion.
questions.answer: Soil erosion is the washing away or removal of topsoil by wind or water. Human activities causing erosion include overgrazing, deforestation, and improper cultivation practices.
markingPoints: Correct definition of soil erosion (1 mark)
First human activity that causes erosion (1 mark)
Second human activity that causes erosion (1 mark)

questions.question: Give three reasons why farmers establish crop nursery beds.
questions.answer: 1. To care for tiny seeds that need close attention. 2. To protect young seedlings from harsh weather. 3. To select healthy seedlings for transplanting.
markingPoints: Protection from harsh environmental conditions (1 mark)
Selection of strong and healthy seedlings (1 mark)

questions.question: State three safety precautions to observe when handling small livestock such as rabbits.
questions.answer: 1. Hold rabbits gently supporting the body and hind legs. 2. Never lift a rabbit by its ears. 3. Wear protective gloves or clothing to avoid scratches.
markingPoints: Proper handling/support of hind legs (1 mark)

questions.question: List three types of farm records that a poultry farmer should maintain.
questions.answer: 1. Egg production record. 2. Feed consumption record. 3. Health/vaccination record.

questions.question: Explain three methods used to conserve water in a school garden.
questions.answer: 1. Mulching: Covering soil with dry grass to reduce evaporation. 2. Drip irrigation: Delivering water directly to plant roots using pipes/bottles. 3. Shading: Constructing shade to reduce direct heat on plants.
markingPoints: Drip irrigation or efficient watering (1 mark)

questions.question: Identify three management practices carried out to care for growing crops in the field.
questions.answer: 1. Weeding to remove unwanted plants. 2. Watering during dry periods. 3. Pest and disease control.

questions.question: State three observable signs of ill-health in farm animals.
questions.answer: 1. Loss of appetite (refusing to eat). 2. Rough or dull coat/feathers. 3. Lethargy or weakness.
markingPoints: Dull/rough coat or skin changes (1 mark)
Lethargy, inactivity, or abnormal discharge (1 mark)

questions.question: Outline three ways of maintaining hand tools used on the farm.
questions.answer: 1. Cleaning tools after use. 2. Oiling/greasing metal parts to prevent rusting. 3. Sharpening cutting edges regularly.

questions.question: Name two common crop pests and state one method of controlling them organically.
questions.answer: Pests: Caterpillars, Aphids. Organic control method: Handpicking pests or spraying with neem extract/soapy water solution.
markingPoints: Valid organic control method stated (1 mark)

questions.question: Mention three organic materials that can be used for mulching in crop production.
questions.answer: 1. Dry grass. 2. Wood shavings/sawdust. 3. Crop residues (e.g., maize stalks).
markingPoints: Dry leaves or crop residues (1 mark)
